sources.name: SPCA Fiji Islands - Our Services
sources.note: Opened; clinic at 155 Foster Road, Walu Bay, Suva; Mon-Sat 8-4:30; phone 8926200; after-hours emergency text line 5-10pm only. No 24 h wording.

sources.name: GoVet Clinic
sources.note: Opened; mobile pet clinic, Makoi, Suva; site states 24/7 and 'Fiji's first 24 hours mobile pet clinic'. Own claims.

sources.name: Animals Fiji - Locations & Clinic Times
sources.note: Opened; four clinics (Nadi, Lautoka, Labasa, Savusavu) with addresses, phones, hours; page says no 24-hour service, emergency line offered on best-effort basis.

sources.name: PASH Fiji
sources.note: Opened; rescue shelter and veterinary clinic; phone and hours, no address or city, no 24 h wording.

sources.name: Biosecurity Authority of Fiji - Quarantine Facilities
sources.note: Opened; import quarantine authority (Koronivia, Nausori, +679 331 2512), no clinic list; not an entry.

entries.name: GoVet Clinic
entries.duty: Mobile pet clinic with home visits and emergency care, stated as available 24/7 across Suva, Nausori, Navua and Pacific Harbour.
entries.note: Second phone +679 788 7319. 24/7 is the clinic's own claim on its site.

duty_i18n.cs: Pojízdná klinika pro domácí zvířata s návštěvami doma a pohotovostní péčí, uváděná jako dostupná nonstop v oblasti Suva, Nausori, Navua a Pacific Harbour.
duty_i18n.sv: Mobil djurklinik med hembesök och akutvård, uppges vara tillgänglig dygnet runt i Suva, Nausori, Navua och Pacific Harbour.

entries.name: SPCA Fiji Islands
entries.duty: Open Monday to Saturday 8:00-16:30. After-hours emergencies only, 17:00-22:00, by text message to 992 2634.
entries.note: Phone given as 8926200 on page; formatted with +679.

duty_i18n.cs: Otevřeno Po–So 8:00–16:30. Mimo ordinační dobu pouze pohotovost 17:00–22:00, SMS zprávou na 992 2634.
duty_i18n.sv: Öppet mån–lör 8.00–16.30. Akutfall utanför öppettider endast 17.00–22.00, via sms till 992 2634.

entries.name: Animals Fiji - Nadi Clinic
entries.duty: Open Monday to Saturday 8:30-17:00, closed Sunday. Emergency and after-hours line on the same number, answered on a best-effort basis (not a 24-hour service).

duty_i18n.cs: Otevřeno Po–So 8:30–17:00, v neděli zavřeno. Pohotovostní linka mimo ordinační dobu na stejném čísle, v rámci možností (nejde o nonstop službu).
duty_i18n.sv: Öppet mån–lör 8.30–17.00, stängt söndagar. Akut- och jourlinje på samma nummer, besvaras i mån av möjlighet (ingen tjänst dygnet runt).

entries.name: Animals Fiji - Lautoka Clinic
entries.address: Bouwalu Street, Namoli Industrial Area, Lautoka
entries.duty: Open Tuesday to Saturday 8:30-17:00; closed Sunday and Monday.

duty_i18n.cs: Otevřeno Út–So 8:30–17:00; v neděli a v pondělí zavřeno.
duty_i18n.sv: Öppet tis–lör 8.30–17.00; stängt sön och mån.

entries.name: Animals Fiji - Labasa Clinic
entries.duty: Open Tuesday to Friday 8:00-17:00 and Saturday 8:00-13:00; closed Sunday and Monday.

duty_i18n.cs: Otevřeno Út–Pá 8:00–17:00 a so 8:00–13:00; v neděli a v pondělí zavřeno.
duty_i18n.sv: Öppet tis–fre 8.00–17.00 och lör 8.00–13.00; stängt sön och mån.

entries.name: Animals Fiji - Savusavu Clinic
entries.address: Nakama, Savusavu (next to Savusavu Medical Centre)
entries.duty: Open Tuesday to Friday 8:30-17:00 and Saturday 8:00-13:00; closed Sunday and Monday.

duty_i18n.cs: Otevřeno Út–Pá 8:30–17:00 a so 8:00–13:00; v neděli a v pondělí zavřeno.
duty_i18n.sv: Öppet tis–fre 8.30–17.00 och lör 8.00–13.00; stängt sön och mån.

entries.name: PASH Fiji
entries.duty: Rescue shelter and veterinary clinic, open Tuesday to Saturday 8:00-17:00. Phone to book.
entries.note: Page gives no address or city; locate before publishing.

duty_i18n.cs: Záchranná stanice a veterinární klinika, otevřeno Út–So 8:00–17:00. Objednání telefonicky.
duty_i18n.sv: Djurhem och veterinärklinik, öppet tis–lör 8.00–17.00. Ring för att boka tid.

notes: Research 2026-11-16; all source_urls opened with WebFetch (official sites first were not reachable by provenance: spcafiji.org, baf.com.fj root, agriculture.gov.fj were blocked and not opened; BAF quarantine page opened). No Fiji Veterinary Association site, duty rota or animal poison line found. Viti Mobile Vet refused by robots. Not added: Pacific Vetcare / Coastal Veterinary Hospital (not confirmed as Fiji, no page opened), Denarau/Coral Coast have no clinic found beyond GoVet mobile coverage of Pacific Harbour. FNU vet programme and BAF quarantine (Koronivia, +679 331 2512) are not clinics.
